integrity: Analytical uniqueness proof; standard-library finite numerical checker corroborates but does not establish generality.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive common wall-release rate, independent exponential bulk and wall clocks, ideal mean absorption times, fixed sum-of-reactivities budget. General published mean-time formulas offer prior ingredients and publication priority remains subject to broader review.
title: Universal interior reactivity allocation for a sticky run-and-tumble particle
